title: Strelley Pool stromatolite reef, Pilbara
note: Earliest widely accepted evidence of life; Allwood et al. 2006 Nature, Duda et al. 2016 PLOS ONE (gives a section coordinate), NASA JPL 2023. Check the Traditional Owners and Indigenous names for the site.

title: Dresser Formation stromatolites and hot-spring deposits, Pilbara
note: Djokic et al. 2017 Nat Commun (open access); Baumgartner et al. 2019 Geology (organic matter in pyrite); Noffke et al. 2013 MISS. Need published outcrop coordinates near the Dresser barite mine.

title: Isua 3.7-billion-year-old stromatolite controversy
note: Nutman et al. 2016 vs Allwood et al. 2018 (Nature); Zawaski et al. 2020 field remapping; Rosing 1999 Isua graphite. Kalaallit Nunaat: record Greenlandic place names.

title: Last universal common ancestor (LUCA)
note: Moody et al. 2024 Nat Ecol Evol (4.09-4.33 Ga); Weiss et al. 2016 Nat Microbiol; Betts et al. 2018. Geometry global; no locatable site.

title: Great Oxidation Event
note: Next step on the early-life thread; key evidence from South Africa (Transvaal/Pongola, oxygenic photosynthesis c. 2,954 Ma cited by Moody 2024) and Western Australia (Hamersley). Favours sub-Saharan Africa coverage.

title: Nuvvuagittuq putative microfossils, Quebec
note: Dodd 2017 Nature, Papineau 2022 Sci Adv (sample coordinates N58°16'50.9" W77°44'14.7"), Québec stratigraphic lexicon for the dating dispute. On Inukjuak Inuit land in Nunavik; include Inuktitut names.
